messages.author: e715a3aeb27b07f3
messages.subject: bar with different width
parts:
Hi there,

I have a strange problem and I don't find a simple data set to
reproduce the behaviour:

I'm generating multiple barplots with facet_wrap. I'm expecting all
bars side by side with position_dodge but instead I get in some plots
bars with a bigger width overlapping a bit and some plots are fine.
The code looks like this:

p <- ggplot(meanDataLong, aes(x = xFactorCol, y = height))
my.dodge <- position_dodge(width=0.9) # need it for errorbars but
even without errorbars the problem occurs
p <- p + geom_bar(aes(fill = colourCol), stat = "identity", position =
my.dodge, colour = "black")
p <- p + facet_wrap(~ template.facet.column, scales="free_y")

Has anybody any idea?

Antje

messages.author: 66a7bbbceef834e9
messages.subject: Re: bar with different width
parts:
I don't know because that code isn't reproducible, but this has come up before on the list. I think that some values of height are NA for certain combinations of x, fill and facet. Or aren't there. The solution is to change those into 0.

HTH
Luciano
